U.S. ARMY MOS 35F

35F Intelligence Analyst

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • ST 101

Minimum AFQT

31

What a 35F Does

Intelligence analysts gather information from many sources and turn it into a clear picture of the enemy and the operating area. You study reports, maps and data, spot patterns and brief leaders on what it means. The job requires a Top Secret clearance and builds strong research and writing skills.

Scores That Count for 35F

  • ST (Skilled Technical) = GS + VE + MK + MC. Study: General Science, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, Mathematics Knowledge, Mechanical Comprehension

Army line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Besides the main sections listed, the Army formula gives a small weight to your other sections too.

Other Requirements

  • Top Secret/SCI clearance eligibility
  • U.S. citizen
  • Normal color vision
  • Never a member of the Peace Corps (limited exceptions)

Related Army Jobs

  • 35N Signals Intelligence Analyst ST 112
  • 17C Cyber Operations Specialist GT 110 and ST 112 and ICTL 60
  • 25B Information Technology Specialist ST 95
  • 31B Military Police ST 91
  • 68K Medical Laboratory Specialist ST 106
